subject: Private deployment pricing — support carve-outs & term smoothing
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@aurelius.health>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@aurelius.health
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on VPC pricing: platform fee amortization and support carve-outs

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week — we were impressed with the throughput and the KV cache behavior. Before we proceed to internal approvals, procurement asked us to clarify a couple of items about the Private (VPC) proposal you shared:

1) Platform fee amortization: can Redwood allow the platform fee to be amortized across the 36‑month term on our P&L? Our finance team needs an explicit schedule and confirmation that there are no periodic surcharges that would break the amortization.

2) Support carve-outs: we have a subset of environments that are fully managed by our infra team and another subset that will be supported by a third‑party MSP. Can we split the support tiers (SRE oncall) by environment so we only pay for Redwood Premium on the environments you operate?

3) Onboarding credit: given the expected scale (12 dedicated nodes initially), are there onboarding or implementation credits you can apply to offset the initial professional services SOW?

Attached is our internal procurement questionnaire (procure_q_Aurelius.xlsx) — we can fill in more details.

Appreciate any specifics and a short timeline to get to a PO.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Engineering
Aurelius Health

[Attachment stub: procure_q_Aurelius.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: soojin.lee@redwood.ai <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@aurelius.health>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC pricing: platform fee amortization and support carve-outs

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, and I can follow with a formal redline/price sheet:  

• Platform fee amortization: yes — we can provide an invoice schedule and a signed commercial addendum that allows your accounting team to amortize over a 36‑month term. There are no recurring “surprise” surcharges; usage overage and optional add‑ons are the only post‑commit items.

• Support carve‑outs: we can carve support by environment. The mechanism is to define two route groups in the SOW — "Managed by Redwood" and "Managed by Aurelius/MSP" — with a reduced SRE retainer for the latter (response SLA instead of 24/7 oncall).

• Onboarding credit: we can offer a one‑time professional services credit tied to a minimum commit; open to discuss credit sizing against the 12‑node starting commit.

I’ve looped in Marissa (commercial) and Sean (billing/credits) to propose concrete terms — expect a draft price sheet and SOW addendum by EOD tomorrow. If you’d like, we can hop on a 30‑min call to run through the amortization schedule.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@aurelius.health>
Cc: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC pricing: support split + proposed options (RDW-2027-4512)

Elena — attaching a compact price sheet and two SOW sketches for the support carve‑out options. Summary below:

Option A — Consolidated: Redwood Premium on all environments
- Platform fee: amortizable, invoice schedule attached
- Support: Premium SRE (24/7) across all nodes
- Onboarding: 15% credit on PS SOW if signed within 30 days
- Headline list price: see Redwood_Private_PriceSheet_v3.xlsx

Option B — Split support (recommended)
- Platform fee: same amortization schedule
- Support: Premium SRE on "production" route group; Response‑SLA retainer on "managed by Aurelius/MSP" route group (reduced cost by ~45%)
- Onboarding: 10% credit on PS SOW + a one‑time implementation assistance package included for first month
- Technical caveat: Redwood will maintain runbook and limited emergency access to MSP‑managed environments under an agreed playbook (attached as SOW addendum).

Legal note: the SOW language in the addendum preserves a single platform license but allows per‑route support rate cards. Irene (legal) is cc'd for a short review on the carve‑out wording.

Attachments: Redwood_Private_PriceSheet_v3.xlsx; SOW_Aurelius_2027.pdf (SOW sketches)

If those look OK, we’ll prepare a PO‑ready schedule and a DocuSign for the SOW + commercial addendum.

Thanks — Marissa
VP, Commercials | Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: Redwood_Private_PriceSheet_v3.xlsx, SOW_Aurelius_2027.pdf]

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai, Elena Morales <elena.morales@aurelius.health>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC pricing: support split + proposed options (RDW-2027-4512)

Quick follow on the credits/finance side:

- We can approve a one‑time onboarding credit equal to 12% of proposed PS fees, applied on first invoice, contingent on a 24‑month minimum commit.
- If Aurelius signs a 36‑month term and pre‑pays 6 months, we can increase the credit to 20% and provide an invoice schedule that explicitly itemizes the platform fee for amortization.

I'll flag billing workflows to ensure finance sends the amortization schedule and a letter confirming no unexpected surcharges other than documented consumption.

—Sean
Director, Customer Finance | Redwood Inference

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@aurelius.health>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC pricing: support split + proposed options (RDW-2027-4512)

Elena / team — legal has reviewed the SOW addendum. Two small asks before we send DocuSign: 

1) Add a clause that clarifies the emergency access playbook is strictly limited to read‑only access unless mutually agreed in writing — helps with auditors.
2) Add an acceptance criteria milestone for the onboarding work so the onboarding credit can be conditioned on completion of the "initial handover checklist" (automates billing triggers).

If Aurelius is comfortable with those points, we’ll issue the DocuSign envelope by EOD tomorrow. Happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer to walk through redlines.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@aurelius.health>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC pricing: support split + proposed options (RDW-2027-4512)

Team — thanks, this aligns well with our needs. We accept Option B (split support) conditional on the two legal edits Irene proposed. We also agree to the 24‑month minimum for the 12% onboarding credit but would like to move to a 30‑day signature window on the PS SOW to secure the credit.

Next steps: please update the SOW addendum with the emergency access sentence and the onboarding acceptance milestone, update the DocuSign to show the 24‑month minimum, and resend. Procurement will route the PO once DocuSign is complete.

Appreciate the rapid turnaround — Elena
Head of Platform Engineering | Aurelius Health
